content: Computing $p(z|x)$ requires an estimate of the marginal likelihood $p(x)$ which is difficult to obtain in practice. A recognition model $q(z|x)$ is used to approximate $p(z|x)$ KL divergence between $p(z|x)$ and $q(z|x)$, as shown in Eq DISPLAY_FORM4, is minimisedBIBREF16.
